findings.body: When close checks an upgrade, it runs the full `forge sync` command in a temporary worktree. `src/forge/sync.py:322` also calls `install_shims`, which can rewrite or rename hooks in the Git hooks directory shared by every worktree (`src/forge/githooks.py:46-50`) and update the shared merge-driver configuration (`src/forge/sync.py:278-307`). Thus even a close that refuses stale files can change the real repository's hooks. Compare the generated files without installing hooks.
findings.title: Keep the sync comparison from changing shared Git hooks

findings.body: `mkdtemp()` creates a parent directory, but the `finally` block removes only its `sync` worktree and branch. Every successful upgrade check leaves the empty parent directory behind. Remove it after the worktree cleanup.
findings.title: Remove the temporary parent directory after the sync check
